title: Clock Generator
text: Generate clock signal with one or more phases, 3 inputs, 5 outputs, {Specify using} sets Define control; {Voltage sensitivity (Hz/V)} sets the measure of change in output frequency, {Free running frequency (Hz)} sets the output frequency without control voltage, {Control voltage (V)} controls voltage values, {Output frequency (Hz)} sets the clock generator output frequency values, {Output amplitude (V)} sets the maximum amplitude of clock generator output, {Phase unit} sets the units of output phase and duty, {Output phase} sets the phases of output clock signals, {Output duty cycle} sets the duty cycle of the output clock signals, {PhaseOffsetPort} defines duty cycle phase offset through an input, {Phase offset (symbol time)} sets the duty cycle phase offset, {ReferenceOffsetPort} defines reference frequency offset through an input, {Reference clock frequency offset (ppm)} sets the factor by which nominal output frequency is to be, {Simulate using} selects simulation mode, {Add phase noise}, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offsets of specified phase noise from carrier frequency, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the specified phase noise power at phase noise frequency offsets relative to the carrier, {Estimate phase noise parameters}, {Period jitter (S)} sets the standard deviation of period jitter, {Flicker corner frequency (Hz)} sets the corner frequency of flicker noise, {Customize flicker exponent (Advanced feature)} sets the customize flicker noise power spectral, {Flicker exponent} sets the flicker noise power exponent, {Plot fit}, {Symbol time (s)} sets the time of single symbol, {Sample interval (s)} sets the uniform time step, {Modulation (2:NRZ, 3:PAM3, 4:PAM4)} sets the modulation scheme and {Input waveform type} sets the type of input. Values come from the instance.
